calls.reason: The Heiding phishing study and the FBI's 2024 notice back the claim that AI makes convincing text cheaply and widens attacks. But nothing shows deepfake video at virtually zero cost, and Unit 42 cites $60–$500 per video.
This open-ended forecast has no deadline, and the packet holds no evidence either way six days after the post.

Stack Overflow's survey shows AI tool use rising from 44% to 62%. A CHI 2022 study shows developers accepting code they didn't understand, and the CCS 2023 study shows AI-suggested SQL-injectable code. One study found little added risk, but that doesn't undercut 'in some cases.'

Google's Q3 2026 tracker and the CyberCartel reporting support hackers making more use of agents. But CyberCartel's core agents ran on Claude Opus and Sonnet, which many would call frontier, so the 'no frontier needed' half is unclear.

The May 2026 Five Eyes guidance says prompt injection is unresolved at the model level, and an OWASP researcher said in June 2026 that it is unsolved. CyberCartel's October 2026 jailbreaks show models were still practically susceptible.
